title: k6 Performance
description: Run-level k6 performance aggregates -- latency percentiles, throughput, error rate, concurrency -- trended across CI runs (qa_collector/parsers/k6_parser.py's parse_k6_metrics, qa-postgres's k6_run_metrics table). This trends build-over-build drift, not a live load-test view: k6's own real-time output (xk6-output-prometheus-remote or InfluxDB streaming during the run) is the right tool for a per-second VU-ramp/request-timeline dashboard -- see docs/qa-kpis.md 'k6 performance metrics'.

list.name: repo
list.label: Repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo_id FROM v_k6_run_metrics ORDER BY 1

list.name: job
list.label: Job
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT job_name FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: source_file
list.label: Script
list.description: A single job (e.g. k6-agentic's 'k6-summary') can bundle multiple --summary-export files for different k6 scripts with different load profiles -- this disambiguates which one a panel is trending. See schema.sql's k6_run_metrics comment.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_file FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT http_req_duration_p95_ms FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY run_started_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT http_req_failed_rate FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY run_started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT http_reqs_rate FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY run_started_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Threshold breaches (last 30 days)
panels.description: k6 checks/thresholds tagged k6-threshold that failed -- see the QA Automation KPIs dashboard's tag-based panels for the same data across all frameworks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS breaches FROM v_test_case_results WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND 'k6-threshold' = ANY(tags) AND status = 'failed' AND run_started_at >= now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Response time percentiles trend (http_req_duration)
panels.description: avg/p90/p95/p99 per run, trended over time -- not a within-run distribution.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_started_at AS time, (job_name || '/' || source_file || ' avg') AS metric, http_req_duration_avg_ms AS value FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT run_started_at AS time, (job_name || '/' || source_file || ' p90') AS metric, http_req_duration_p90_ms AS value FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT run_started_at AS time, (job_name || '/' || source_file || ' p95') AS metric, http_req_duration_p95_ms AS value FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT run_started_at AS time, (job_name || '/' || source_file || ' p99') AS metric, http_req_duration_p99_ms AS value FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT run_started_at AS time, (job_name || '/' || source_file) AS metric, http_req_failed_rate AS value FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT run_started_at AS time, (job_name || '/' || source_file || ' req/s') AS metric, http_reqs_rate AS value FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT run_started_at AS time, (job_name || '/' || source_file || ' iter/s') AS metric, iterations_rate AS value FROM v_k6_run_metrics WHERE repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent k6 runs
panels.description: 'CI Run' opens the GitHub Actions run this row's metrics came from.

targets.rawSql: SELECT vkm.run_started_at AS time, vkm.repo_id, vkm.job_name, vkm.source_file, vkm.branch, vkm.http_req_duration_p95_ms, vkm.http_req_failed_rate, vkm.http_reqs_rate, vkm.vus_max, vkm.workflow_run_id AS ci_run, r.github_org, r.github_repo FROM v_k6_run_metrics vkm JOIN repos r ON r.id = vkm.repo_id WHERE vkm.repo_id IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND vkm.job_name IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND vkm.source_file IN (${source_file:sqlstring}) ORDER BY vkm.run_started_at DESC LIMIT 25
